heroTitle: Showcase your skills, find clients, or post a job and connect with the right professional.
heroSubtitle: DHIIL is a platform that connects skilled professionals with people and businesses looking for work to be done.
featurePostDesc: Describe the work you need done and quickly find a qualified professional who can get the job done.
featureProfileDesc: Create your professional profile and showcase your skills, experience, and past work to potential clients.
howItWorksStep1: Post or Showcase: Clients post jobs, while professionals create profiles to showcase their skills and experience.
howItWorksStep2: Apply for Jobs: Professionals browse available jobs and apply to the ones that match their skills.
howItWorksStep3: Choose the Right Professional: Clients review applications, shortlist candidates, and select the professional who best fits their needs.
howItWorksStep4: Get the Work Done: The professional completes the job, the client receives the finished work, and the professional gets paid.
